Q: Error: unnamed module of loader org.eclipse.osgi.internal.loader.EquinoxClassLoader A:

This is due to the changes within Java 9 (Jigsaw). See https://www.logicbig.com/tutorials/core-java-tutorial/modules/unnamed-modules.html.

We had similar issues in our product when upgrading to java 11. This has probably something to do with old libraries which export org.xml.sax somehow. We've upgraded or replaced those libraries to get it fixed

Q: Build a health Indicator spring boot A:

Here my application.yml

server:
  servlet-path: /api
  port: 8080

mongodb:
  host: conexion
  port: 27017
  databaseName: abc
  #uri: conexion

management:
  context-path: /admin

endpoints:
  health:
    enabled: yes
  shutdown:
    enabled: yes

logging:
   # Enable this to specify the path and the name of the log file. By default, it creates a
   # file named spring.log in the temp directory.
   file: /tmp/abc.log      

   # Add other levels if you want to override the level configured in the logback.xml configuration file.
   level: 
   com.abc: INFO

Q: Shutdown computer, how operating systems achieve it? (C Kernel development) A:

It’s an ACPI S5 State Transition

You don't just "stop" the CPU. You must interface with the ACPI (FADT table) to trigger the S5 (Soft Off) power state.

​The Architect’s Execution:

​Parse the FADT to find the PM1a_CNT_BLK register.

​Send the SLP_TYP (Sleep Type) and SLP_EN bit.

​Critical: Ensure atomic state synchronization before the power-off to prevent data corruption.

​Proof of my Atomic Sub-Slot Verification (SSAV) at 85ns
